user.title: Add room
user.description: One room is controlled by one TRV (radiator thermostat).

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: Extra temperature sensors (the TRV's own temperature is always used) and window/door sensors that block heating when open.

reference.title: Reference sensor
reference.description: The sensor that best represents how the room feels. It is shown as the room temperature and offset suggestions are relative to it.

params.title: Control parameters
params.description: Defaults are fine for most rooms. Gain, hysteresis and vacation temperature can be tuned later from the dashboard.

data.min_boost: Minimum heating boost above TRV temperature
data.stop_margin: Setpoint below TRV temperature when stopping
data.min_write_interval: Minimum time between TRV setpoint changes

abort.already_configured: This TRV is already used by another room.
